decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis (Cav.) Trin. ex Steud.
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis (Cav.) Trin. ex Steud.
decisions.reason: WCVP/POWO accepts species rank in Poaceae; retain one existing canonical species concept and treat North American lineages below species.

decisions.source_name: Arundo australis Cav.
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis (Cav.) Trin. ex Steud.
decisions.reason: POWO lists the 1799 Arundo australis as homotypic synonym/basionym, not an additional accepted learner species.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis subsp. americanus Saltonst., P.M.Peterson & Soreng
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. americanus Saltonst., P.M.Peterson & Soreng
decisions.reason: POWO accepts the North American native lineage at subspecies rank, first published Sida 21:690 (2004).

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis subsp. australis
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. australis
decisions.reason: POWO accepts the autonym for the Eurasian lineage, separate from americanus and berlandieri at subspecies rank.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis subsp. berlandieri (E.Fourn.) Saltonst. & Hauber
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. berlandieri (E.Fourn.) Saltonst. & Hauber
decisions.reason: POWO accepts the Gulf Coast taxon at subspecies rank, combination published in J. Bot. Res. Inst. Texas 1:387 (2007); geographic-origin disagreement is tracked separately.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis subsp. isiacus (Arcang.) J.H.Xue, Chepinoga & K.P.Ma
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. isiacus (Arcang.) J.H.Xue, Chepinoga & K.P.Ma
decisions.reason: POWO lists four accepted infraspecific taxa globally; isiacus is the fourth, not a fourth lineage proven in Texas. Do not invent a Texas record or new card.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites americanus (Saltonst., P.M.Peterson & Soreng) A.Haines
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. americanus
decisions.reason: POWO records this species-rank combination as a homotypic synonym of the accepted native subspecies; not a second installed species.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis var. americanus (Saltonst., P.M.Peterson & Soreng) Tiehm
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. americanus
decisions.reason: POWO records Tiehm's 2023 variety-rank combination as a homotypic synonym of accepted subsp. americanus.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites berlandieri E.Fourn.
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. berlandieri
decisions.reason: POWO identifies the 1877 basionym as homotypic synonym of accepted Gulf Coast subspecies.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis var. berlandieri (E.Fourn.) C.F.Reed
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. berlandieri
decisions.reason: POWO treats the historical variety-rank combination as a homotypic synonym, not a separate accepted variety.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites communis subsp. berlandieri (E.Fourn.) Á.Löve
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. berlandieri
decisions.reason: POWO maps the historical subspecies combination under P. communis to the accepted berlandieri subspecies.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites communis var. berlandieri (E.Fourn.) Fernald
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. berlandieri
decisions.reason: POWO maps the historical variety combination under P. communis to the accepted berlandieri subspecies.

decisions.source_name: Phragmites maximus var. berlandieri (E.Fourn.) Moldenke
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis subsp. berlandieri
decisions.reason: POWO maps the historical P. maximus variety to the accepted Gulf Coast subspecies.

decisions.source_name: Three North American Phragmites australis subspecies in Lindsay et al. (2023)
decisions.accepted_target: Three recognized subspecies; source-validated chloroplast qPCR assay combinations
decisions.reason: The 2023 primary protocol validates a combination of qPCR assays that discriminates americanus, australis and berlandieri on its tested U.S. specimens. It does not identify untested learner photographs.

decisions.source_name: Nuclear NRT2 and PaGT4 markers in Wendell et al. (2025)
decisions.accepted_target: Validated screen for americanus vs non-americanus and potential F1 hybrids
decisions.reason: The 2025 primary study supports two independent nuclear markers to screen for native americanus and potential hybrids, with follow-up confirmation for suspected hybrids.

decisions.source_name: Automatic synonymization of Phragmites americanus into Eurasian subsp. australis
decisions.accepted_target: Keep synonym mapped only to P. australis subsp. americanus
decisions.reason: Species-rank homotypic alias of the native subspecies cannot be collapsed into the Eurasian autonym or used to label native specimens invasive.

decisions.source_name: Automatic synonymization of Phragmites berlandieri into P. australis subsp. australis
decisions.accepted_target: Keep synonym mapped only to P. australis subsp. berlandieri
decisions.reason: Distinct accepted Gulf Coast subspecies and its five homotypic aliases must not be merged into Eurasian autonym.

decisions.source_name: Invasive-status inference from species-level Phragmites australis label
decisions.accepted_target: No lineage or invasiveness decision from unqualified species name
decisions.reason: The species encompasses multiple accepted subspecies with distinct North American histories; a species-level label cannot prove introduced Eurasian ancestry.

decisions.source_name: Claim that NRT2/PaGT4 nuclear markers alone distinguish Eurasian subsp. australis from Gulf subsp. berlandieri
decisions.accepted_target: These two nuclear markers distinguish americanus vs others, not australis vs berlandieri
decisions.reason: Wendell et al. explicitly state the two-marker nuclear screen cannot separate the Eurasian and Gulf taxa; use validated lineage assays/sequencing where needed.

decisions.source_name: Individual Texas Phragmites photographs, vouchers and field observations
decisions.accepted_target: Phragmites australis lineage unresolved until independent determination
decisions.reason: Accepted-name audit does not authenticate any existing gallery image, phenotype, or Hays County observation; do not infer subspecies from panicle, sheath, or habitat alone.

decisions.source_name: Putative native x introduced Phragmites hybrid or introgression in any learner specimen
decisions.accepted_target: No specimen-level hybrid ancestry established
decisions.reason: Morphological intermediacy and chloroplast haplotype alone cannot establish biparental hybrid ancestry; nuclear-marker screening and independent confirmation are required.

decisions.source_name: Gulf Coast berlandieri geographic-origin and hybrid-origin interpretations
decisions.accepted_target: Accepted taxon P. australis subsp. berlandieri; origin remains authority-qualified
decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP labels berlandieri native to Texas, whereas Lindsay et al. 2023 call its U.S. origins cryptogenic and 2024 ecological literature argues some Gulf types non-native. Preserve conflict without county nativity audit or forced native/invasive badge.

decisions.source_name: Unvouchered historical Phragmites communis / P. australis sensu lato / Gulf-type records
decisions.accepted_target: Require author, rank, specimen history and/or genetic evidence before mapping lineage
decisions.reason: Historical broad labels and some cpDNA tests can conflate lineages; 2025 research documents introduced Asian haplotype AS that could be mistaken for Gulf type by older RFLP interpretation.

scientific_holds_preserved: Taxonomy does not authenticate any individual gallery photograph or field specimen.
Do not label species-level Phragmites australis observations automatically invasive or native; lineage determination required.
No specimen-level hybrid/introgression inferred without nuclear evidence and follow-up confirmation.
Kew Texas-native treatment of berlandieri and primary-study cryptogenic/non-native Gulf origin remain explicitly authority-qualified.
Do not treat NRT2/PaGT4 nuclear marker results as a standalone Eurasian-versus-Gulf discriminator.
scope_exclusions: no photo sourcing or image writes
